items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: He took like Albert Dominic. Oh, yeah. That's my voice good cousin too.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was way behind me. He wasn't up much. I heard... He was bashful. He was too bashful.
I heard he played saxophone mostly down here, I guess, did he? Yeah, he was bashful. He didn't do much playing. He took like Albert Dominic. Oh, yeah. That's my voice good cousin too.
When they call Don Albert now. Don Albert trumpet bell. Yeah, yeah. That's my question.
